fixed.explanation: _retryAction waits between retries by evaluating setTimeout in the page's utility world, which hangs when JavaScript is disabled. Replace it with a server-side timer raced through progress.

input.intent: Action retry loop in the injected-script based progress/retry mechanism waits between retries using a page-side script (e.g. requestAnimationFrame or evaluate-based wait/timeouts). Needs to work when JavaScript is disabled, so the wait between retries should happen on the server side rather than via page scripts.
input.symptom: With JavaScript disabled in the browser context, a click that needs to retry hangs forever between retries because the retry wait relies on page scripts.
